chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Mahbub, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Indeed, the Commander of the Believers (peace be upon him) used to go out with loads of date stones. It would be said to him: 'O Abu al-Hasan! What is this with you?' He would say: 'Palm trees, God willing.' He would plant them, and not a single one of them failed to sprout.

key_terms.أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Believers — the title of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (AS)
key_terms.إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ: If God wills (Inshallah) — an expression of reliance on Divine will (tawakkul)
key_terms.النَّوَى: Date stones/pits — the seeds from which palm trees grow
key_terms.نَخْلٌ: Palm trees — edible and economically valuable trees

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali do with date stones when he went out?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates that Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (AS), the Commander of the Believers, would regularly go out carrying loads of date stones and plant them as palm trees, saying 'In sha' Allah' (if God wills) when asked about them. Remarkably, every single date stone he planted would successfully grow into a palm tree. Transmitted through Imam al-Sadiq (AS), this account appears in the chapter on emulating the Imams' example in livelihood, highlighting how the first Imam's combination of personal labor and reliance on God's will resulted in complete success — serving as a model for how believers should approach their work.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said that

Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> went out and with him<sup>asws</sup> was a load of date stones. So it was said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘O Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>! What is this with you<sup>asws</sup>?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Palm trees, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Willing’. So he<sup>asws</sup> planted them, and not a single one of them failed to sprout’.
en.sarwar: 9. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ibn Mahbub from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that ’Amir al-Mu’minin, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, would go to work with large quantities of date stones. He was asked, ‘What are these, O abu al-Hassan?’ He (the Imam) replied, ‘They are palm trees, by the will of Allah.’ He then planted them and not a single piece failed sprouting.”
